injuries.name: DaRon Bland
injuries.note: Bland sustained a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyler Booker
injuries.note: Booker suffered a high ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News  reports.

injuries.name: Tyler Goodson
injuries.note: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: C.J. West
injuries.note: West (knee) won't be activated from IR ahead of Sunday's Week 10 clash against the Cowboys, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Hobbs
injuries.note: The 49ers aren't activating Hobbs (adductor) ahead of Sunday's tilt against Dallas, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injuries.name: Gracen Halton
injuries.note: Halton recently underwent surgery to repair a broken leg and dislocated ankle that he suffered during the 49ers' Week 9 win over the Raiders, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
